title: Metric Unit Errors Put One Orbiter At 57 Kilometers
hook: A unit error put one orbiter at 57 kilometers.
closing: Units matter because a correct number with the wrong system can still cause failure.
question: Where have mixed units caused trouble?

segments.say: Non-metric countries contain 5% of the world's population. Different systems still meet across borders.
The orbiter's actual altitude was 57 kilometers. A unit mismatch put it far below the plan.
The airliner loaded 20,400 pounds of fuel. The mistaken calculation left it far short of the needed amount.
